name: MyBot check-in
description: Asks one question each evening so the record stays complete.
schedule: Daily at 21:00 in the owner's timezone, or the time the owner picks when switching it on.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, no record yet, today already logged, or paused.
job: Run the check-in in mybot-main-job. Read the Sheet first. Send one short question, at most one message, never a chaser.

name: MyBot look-ahead
description: Looks each day for anything falling due soon, and says nothing unless something does.
schedule: Daily at 08:00 in the owner's timezone, or the time the owner picks when switching it on.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, nothing due inside the look-ahead window, or the owner was already told about it.
job: The pattern for anything date-driven: a daily check at a fixed time, quiet unless due. Read the Sheet, work out what falls due inside the window, and send one short message only if something does. A routine has no 'run on this date' trigger, so never try to schedule one per due date. Delete this routine if the bot has nothing date-driven.
